decision: Accept the frozen map material/detail improvement as a bounded native visual checkpoint. The jagged downward-pointing Lotus defect is corrected; no blocking placement/readability defect is apparent in the five reviewed originals. This is not finished AAA environment acceptance.

actual_capture.scope: Actual native rendered screens and geometry. Fixture authority states stage plant/results for art review; not natural gameplay/input or hardware performance proof.

frozen_source.digest_attribution: Combined runtime identity supplied by root; this review independently compares the five relevant source bindings below against capture, working source and frozen snapshot.

observations.finding: Five upward lobes now meet a shared lower base. The earlier star/maple silhouette and downward side spikes are gone. The front-on close-up still reads as a shallow inlay; internal petal separation and beveled depth are visually subtle, so this is not a detailed sculptural-carving qualification.
Three separated diamonds remain aligned with the indigo masonry panel. The bevel is restrained and no floating/disconnected face is apparent. Fine surface grain remains visible in this close view.

The corrected Lotus identity is legible on divider/stall inserts at gameplay distance. Metre-scale wall/counter courses and subdued stone tones break the prior flat tan treatment. The reticle corridor, A label and cover silhouette remain clear in this staged empty-lane view.

New relief follows the established perimeter/divider/cover placement; the two-site layout and existing galleries remain apparent. Large open courts, repeated facade modules and a regular decorative band remain visible production limitations.

Indigo facade, pale masonry and muted floor retain clear material roles. B label and orange site outline remain distinct. This view does not establish enemy visibility under representative combat populations.

limits: Only five named originals from the22-screen combined capture personally reviewed in this receipt; the other17screens belong to their owners.
Staged stills are not continuous traversal, natural OS input, combat balance or hardware performance evidence.
Materials and motifs improve readable identity but remain simpler than a finished dense commercial hero-shooter city.
Relief depth is still subtle in the front-on captures; no claim that internal sculptural detail is strongly resolved.
No frozen runtime file was changed during this review.
